What you need to know
Tick each one you know.
Function: each input has exactly one output. One-one and many-one mappings are functions; one-many is not.
Domain and range: the inputs and the outputs. For f(x) = 2x, 1 ≤ x ≤ 3, the range is 2 ≤ f(x) ≤ 6.
Completing the square: x2 − 6x + 11 = (x − 3)2 + 2. A square is never negative.
Rising or falling: if a graph only rises (or only falls) on an interval, its end points give the smallest and largest outputs.
